issues.issue: Has the Minister unreasonably delayed the permanent residence decision, so that mandamus is warranted?
issues.applicant_position: Delay exceeds published 26-month processing time; applicant not responsible and responded promptly to requests.
issues.respondent_position: Delay is not longer than process requires given complexity, security screening and COVID-19.
issues.result_text: Delay unexplained; blanket security-screening and pandemic assertions lack evidence; delay unreasonable.

issues.issue: Does the balance of convenience favour granting mandamus?
issues.applicant_position: Delay has prejudiced him, leaving him in life limbo.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents gave no evidence of inconvenience from an order directing a decision.
issues.result_text: Applicant prejudiced by delay; respondents showed no inconvenience; balance of convenience favours applicant.

issues.issue: What deadline should apply to the decision ordered?
issues.applicant_position: Requests a decision within 60 days of judgment.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel had no instructions on the relief deadline.
issues.result_text: 60-day deadline appropriate absent evidence it is unreasonable or unfair; extension possible by motion.
